integrityControls.scope: Source, context, range, UTF-8 and exact release/source review checks plus exact sidecar inventory/hash, unsupported sidecar rejection and sequential-execution requirements.

limitations: Linux x64 installed .25 comparisons only; full API, latest-release suite and six-platform acceptance remain incomplete.
Original expressions, assertions and deadlines retain their bytes. Source-hidden relocation with empty PATH is tested; no kernel source/tool denial here.
Original #eval registrations remain native-build-time; additional AOT API observations are separate.
async_tcp_half executes only upstream listenClose. Its unused acceptClose definition is not half-close assertion coverage.
Guarded/scoped/non-IO tests and unreviewed sidecar types remain unsupported by this narrow parallel adapter.

Successful generated outputs use the existing suite cleanup policy after recording hashes and exact results; only the Node tempfile binaries retain verified gzip archives. Failed outputs are preserved.
